name: Click Assist
description: Widens the timing window for frame-perfect clicks. Click up to a few frames early and the click is held, then fired on the exact frame it needs to land.

window.name: Early-click window (frames)
window.description: How many frames early a click still counts. One frame is 1/240 s. A value of 4 turns a 1-frame window into a 5-frame window.
